name: assertMultiClass
title: Returns the value when it is an object that inherits at least one of the given classes

origin.description: Returns the value when it is an object that inherits at least one of the given classes. Otherwise it stops with the check message.
origin.usage: assertMultiClass(x, classes, null.ok = FALSE, .var.name = vname(x), add = NULL)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Value under test. A Python int is an R integer and a Python float is an R double.

arguments.name: .var.name
arguments.text: Name used in the assertion message.

arguments.name: add
arguments.text: Collection that stores the message instead of stopping.

origin.details: Returns the value when it is an object that inherits at least one of the given classes. Otherwise it stops with the check message.
origin.value: The value when the check passes. Otherwise the check stops.
